description: This file implements traversal and processing of Git objects such as commits, trees, blobs, and tags, with filtering and filtering logic incorporated.

classes.name: traversal_context
classes.description: Structure holding traversal context including revision info, callbacks for showing objects and commits, filter, depth, and associated data.

methods.name: void show_commit(struct traversal_context * ctx,struct commit * commit)
methods.description: Calls the show_commit callback if set, to display a commit.

methods.name: void show_object(struct traversal_context * ctx,struct object * object,const char * name)
methods.description: Calls the show_object callback if set, to display an object, considering pack presence and interest.

methods.name: void process_blob(struct traversal_context * ctx,struct blob * blob,struct strbuf * path,const char * name)
methods.description: Filters and potentially shows a blob object, integrates with filtering logic, and checks for promisor objects.

methods.name: void process_tree_contents(struct traversal_context * ctx,struct tree * tree,struct strbuf * base)
methods.description: Processes the entries of a tree, handling directories and blobs, applying filtering, and recursion.

methods.name: void process_tree(struct traversal_context * ctx,struct tree * tree,struct strbuf * base,const char * name)
methods.description: Handles processing of a tree object including parsing, filtering, displaying, and processing its contents.

methods.name: void process_tag(struct traversal_context * ctx,struct tag * tag,const char * name)
methods.description: Filters and potentially shows a tag object.

methods.name: void mark_edge_parents_uninteresting(struct commit * commit,struct rev_info * revs,show_edge_fn show_edge)
methods.description: Marks parent commits of a given commit as uninteresting and optionally displays edges.

methods.name: void add_edge_parents(struct commit * commit,struct rev_info * revs,show_edge_fn show_edge,struct oidset * set)
methods.description: Adds parent trees of a commit to a set and marks uninteresting parents.

methods.name: void mark_edges_uninteresting(struct rev_info * revs,show_edge_fn show_edge,int sparse)
methods.description: Marks commit edges or trees as uninteresting based on filtering, supporting sparse mode.

methods.name: void add_pending_tree(struct rev_info * revs,struct tree * tree)
methods.description: Adds a tree object to the pending list in revision info for traversal.

methods.name: void traverse_non_commits(struct traversal_context * ctx,struct strbuf * base)
methods.description: Processes and filters non-commit objects pending for traversal.

methods.name: void do_traverse(struct traversal_context * ctx)
methods.description: Main traversal loop over revisions, processing commits, trees, blobs, and invoking display callbacks.

methods.name: void traverse_commit_list_filtered(struct rev_info * revs,show_commit_fn show_commit,show_object_fn show_object,void * show_data,struct oidset * omitted)
methods.description: Public function to initiate a filtered traversal of a commit list, calling show callbacks.
